# Wall Thickness Transition

Abrupt change in thickness where one wall steps to another.

<figure markdown="span">
![Wall Thickness Transition: on the left what to avoid, on the right what to aim for](../../assets/diagrams/max-wall-thickness-variation-light.svg#only-light){ width="640" }
![Wall Thickness Transition: on the left what to avoid, on the right what to aim for](../../assets/diagrams/max-wall-thickness-variation-dark.svg#only-dark){ width="640" }
<figcaption>Change in thickness where a wall steps to another; blend it over a taper at least 3 times the step.</figcaption>
</figure>

## Where it applies

| Process | Criticality |
| :-- | :-- |
| [Plastic Injection Molding](../../reference/processes/plastic-injection-molding.md) | High |
| [Powder Bed Fusion (SLS)](../../reference/processes/powder-bed-fusion.md) | Medium |

## Values

**Aim for** is what to design for; crossing it gives a warning. **At most** is the hard limit; crossing it gives an error. See [aim for and limits](../../concepts/aim-for-and-limits.md).

=== "Plastic Injection Molding"

    Criticality in this process: **High** ([what this means](../../concepts/criticality.md)).

    | Material | Aim for | At most | Source |
    | :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
    | **Default** | 15% of the thicker wall | 25% of the thicker wall | Not yet sourced |
    | Acetal / POM | 10% of the thicker wall | 15% of the thicker wall | Not yet sourced |
    | LCP | 10% of the thicker wall | 15% of the thicker wall | Not yet sourced |
    | PA | 10% of the thicker wall | 15% of the thicker wall | Not yet sourced |
    | PET / PBT | 10% of the thicker wall | 15% of the thicker wall | Not yet sourced |
    | PE | 10% of the thicker wall | 15% of the thicker wall | Not yet sourced |
    | PP | 10% of the thicker wall | 15% of the thicker wall | Not yet sourced |

    Every other material uses the Default values: PLA, ABS, PMMA, Long-Fiber Reinforced Plastics, PC, PSU, PS, PUR, PVC.


=== "Powder Bed Fusion (SLS)"

    Criticality in this process: **Medium** ([what this means](../../concepts/criticality.md)).

    | Material | Aim for | At most | Source |
    | :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
    | **Default** | 25% of the thicker wall | 50% of the thicker wall | Engineering judgement, [Formlabs](../../citations/bibliography.md#formlabs-fuse "Both advise even walls and smooth transitions, without a figure. Looser than molding's 15% / 25%"), [HP](../../citations/bibliography.md#hp-mjf) |

    Every other material uses the Default values: PA12 (SLS), PA12 (MJF), PA11, PA12 Carbon-filled, TPU.


## Messages

What the results panel says about a finding. You can rewrite these in the Process Library; the words in `{braces}` are filled in for each finding.

=== "Plastic Injection Molding"

    !!! warning "Warning"

        Wall Thickness Change (`{measured}`): the wall steps `{size}`, more than the recommended `{target}` of the thicker wall. The two sections cool and shrink at different rates, which can warp the part. Blend the change over a taper at least `{ramp}` long (3 times the step).
    !!! failure "Error"

        Abrupt Wall Thickness Change (`{measured}`): the wall steps `{size}`, past `{limit}` of the thicker wall. Expect warping, sink and internal stress where the sections meet, and hesitation as the plastic flows from thick to thin. Make the walls more even, or taper the change over at least `{ramp}` (3 times the step).

=== "Powder Bed Fusion (SLS)"

    !!! warning "Warning"

        Wall thickness change (`{measured}`): the wall steps `{size}`, more than the recommended `{target}` of the thicker wall. Thick and thin sections cool at different rates in the powder, which builds stress and can warp the part. Blend the change over at least `{ramp}`.
    !!! failure "Error"

        Abrupt wall thickness change (`{measured}`): the wall steps `{size}`, past `{limit}` of the thicker wall. Expect warping where the sections meet. Make the walls more even, or taper the change over at least `{ramp}`.

| Placeholder | Replaced with |
| :-- | :-- |
| `{measured}` | The measured value, with its unit |
| `{target}` | The rule's "Aim for" value |
| `{limit}` | The rule's "At most" value |
| `{feature}` | What it is about, such as "Boss 3 (screw)" or "Face12" |
| `{size}` | Its size or what was found, such as "Ø3.00 mm and 9.00 mm deep" |
| `{ramp}` | The length to taper the change over (3 times the step) |
